coverage_summary: Reviewed all six OpticalDNA pretraining trajectories, including rendering, task sampling, ROI construction, masking, truncation, visual encoding, fusion, prompt/decoder conditioning, and no-truncation bypasses. Several blocking omissions and unsupported bindings require revision.

findings.detail: The sampler outputs page-coordinate roi_boxes directly from genomic_sequence, while the paper specifies sampling a source line and contiguous character span first; conversion to boxes requires the rendered-line annotations. The stated uncertainty does not repair this port mismatch.

evidence.quote: Each span is instantiated by selecting a source line and taking a contiguous character span of length n base within that line.
For each page p , we store an ordered list of nucleotide annotations

findings.required_change: Add the missing span intermediate and an opaque span-to-box mapping using page annotations; do not bind genomic_sequence directly as a box-producing sampler output.

findings.detail: T2 contains page-patch, front-end, projected-token, attention, and fused-token nodes, but its only visual step is an opaque encode_and_fuse_document_pages call. The paper states the ordered patchification, front-end encoding, projection, self-attention fusion, and mean page reduction, so these documented calls should not be omitted.

evidence.quote: We partition each page into non-overlapping 16 × 16 patches and encode them with the SAM-Conv-CLIP-L visual front-end.
We then apply a learned projector Π θ
We instantiate F θ as a multi-head self-attention module with one attention layer and 20 heads, followed by a mean reduction over the page dimension

findings.required_change: Reuse the documented partition, opaque front-end, project, self_attention, and mean-reduction boundary calls, preserving their order and connecting the existing intermediate nodes.

findings.detail: T2 has task and prompt-length sampling but no task-specific prompt-construction step or task_prompt node. Its user_message evidence only establishes the image placeholder, while the decoder must receive the task prompt as part of the user message.

findings.required_change: Add an opaque task-prompt selection/serialization boundary driven by task_index and prompt_length_variant, then connect its output and the ordered pages to the multimodal user message.

findings.detail: The T2 truncation call omits the documented truncation-rate controls. The paper gives stage-specific rho_base/rho_max values, while the assembly records only an unspecified optional truncation.

findings.detail: T3 omits the shared task-index and prompt-length sampling branch and has no prompt-construction step, despite using a task-specific ROI prompt. The task_prompt node is therefore disconnected from the decoder path.

findings.detail: The T3 tail-truncation step is left opaque even though the paper documents suffix deletion, whiteout of truncated ROI boxes, empty-page removal, page reindexing, and consistency repair. It also fails to output the retained model_roi_boxes, so target construction continues to reference the untruncated boxes.

For the truncated items, we additionally white out their corresponding bounding-box regions on the rendered pages, and then drop empty pages and re-index remaining pages to preserve image-annotation consistency.

findings.required_change: Represent the documented conditional branch, including retained ROI items, whiteout, empty-page selection, annotation reindexing, and the no-truncation bypass.
